## Change

Describe what changed and why. Link any related issue.

## Checks performed

List the builds or manual checks you actually performed, with results. Mention anything you could not check. For UI changes, include sample-data views in light and dark appearance.

## Compatibility

Explain any effect on existing controls, saved data, device integrations or accessibility. Describe migration behavior if a stored format changes.

## Privacy and attribution

Confirm that screenshots and diagnostics contain no credentials or household data. Identify third-party code or assets and their licenses; disclose substantial AI assistance if used.
